headline_seed: Manhunt for suspected gunman aged 89 as five wounded in Athens
description_seed: Five people were left with life-threatening injuries, according to Greece's state broadcaster ERT.

what: Manhunt for suspected gunman aged 89 as five wounded in Athens

clean_source_blocks.text: Five people were left with life-threatening injuries, according to Greece's state broadcaster ERT.
A manhunt has been launched in Athens for an 89-year-old suspect following a shooting spree which left five people injured, according to police and local media reports.
ERT reported the five people - a man and four women - were left with non-life-threatening injuries in the shootings.
"Four women working at the small claims court were slightly injured," the head of the judiciary employees' union in Athens, Stratis Dounias, told the broadcaster.

ERT reported the five people - a man and four women - were left with non-life-threatening injuries in the shootings.

"Four women working at the small claims court were slightly injured," the head of the judiciary employees' union in Athens, Stratis Dounias, told the broadcaster.
